competitors.title: SHRED uses Fireblocks, an institutional-grade digital asset custody platform trusted by leading exch
competitors.description:
SHRED uses Fireblocks, an institutional-grade digital asset custody platform trusted by leading exchanges and funds, to securely hold and move user assets.

All funds are stored in Fireblocks Vault accounts protected by multi-party computation (MPC), eliminating single private-key risk by distributing signing authority across multiple parties.

Every transaction passes through a strict rule engine and allow-listed destinations, meaning assets can only move to pre-approved wallets, exchanges, or contracts.

Beyond Fireblocks’ native safeguards, SHRED adds an independent guardian layer that performs automated cross-checks through multiple systems before any transfer is finalized, creating an extra institutional-grade validation step.

For users, none of this adds friction. When you deposit into SHRED, your funds are custodied through Fireblocks and governed by multiple layers of automated, policy-based security before a single coin moves.

competitors.title: Institutional Adoption Accelerates as Anchorage Integrates TRON into Regulated Crypto Infrastructure
competitors.description:
Institutional Adoption Accelerates as Anchorage Integrates TRON into Regulated Crypto Infrastructure

Institutional participation continues to shape the evolution of blockchain adoption, and the latest integration between Anchorage Digital and TRON represents another major step toward bridging traditional finance with decentralized networks.

As the first federally chartered crypto bank in the United States, Anchorage provides compliant digital asset custody solutions trusted by institutions seeking secure and regulated exposure to blockchain ecosystems.

With TRON now supported on Anchorage’s platform, institutional clients gain the ability to securely custody TRX within a regulatory framework designed to meet strict financial compliance standards.

This development strengthens confidence among professional investors, asset managers, and enterprises looking to access blockchain-based financial infrastructure while maintaining operational transparency and risk management controls.

Beyond custody, the next phase of integration is expected to expand support for TRC20 assets as well as native TRX staking capabilities.

These additional features will enable institutions not only to hold TRX securely, but also to actively participate in network validation mechanisms, contributing to the decentralization and security of the TRON blockchain.

By enabling staking participation, institutions can engage more deeply with the network while potentially benefiting from blockchain-based incentive structures aligned with long-term ecosystem growth.

The integration demonstrates how compliant infrastructure providers are increasingly supporting high-performance networks capable of handling large-scale stablecoin settlement, DeFi applications, and global payment flows.

TRON’s strong presence in stablecoin activity and decentralized finance continues to position it as a key settlement layer for digital asset transactions worldwide.

Institutional-grade custody solutions such as Anchorage play an important role in enabling broader adoption by reducing barriers related to security, governance, and regulatory clarity.

As more compliant financial institutions integrate TRON infrastructure, the ecosystem becomes more accessible to global capital markets seeking efficient blockchain-based financial rails.

The collaboration reflects a broader trend in which digital asset innovation is increasingly supported by trusted financial institutions, reinforcing confidence in the long-term development of decentralized economic systems.

Learn more: https://t.co/8Go71JxRUd

industry.title:
🇺🇸The Clarity Act is stuck as the fight over stablecoin yield reaches the final stage.

The CLARITY
industry.description:
🇺🇸The Clarity Act is stuck as the fight over stablecoin yield reaches the final stage.

The CLARITY Act passed the House (294–134) with strong bipartisan backing, with support from Donald Trump. Cynthia Lummis said stablecoin negotiations are “99% done.”

But the situation has now shifted.

The bill is stuck in a four-way deadlock, with banks, the Senate, the crypto industry, and critics each holding enough leverage to slow or block progress.

The main friction point is stablecoin yield. Banks are pushing back due to risks of deposit outflows, while the industry wants to keep yield opportunities open.

Right now, it’s all about closing the gaps between these sides.

🔹Power is split across all sides
🔹Final terms are still being shaped
🔹Consensus is not fully locked yet

What happens next depends on how this deadlock gets resolved. That will decide how fast the bill moves forward.

@SenLummis
